name: Chowking
notes: Chain location page (locations.chowkingusa.com) links to the restaurant's own Olo ordering platform (order.chowkingusa.com/menu/mira-mesa) for this specific San Diego store, address-matched (8955 Mira Mesa Blvd). The Olo Next.js app is fully client-rendered with no server-side JSON-LD and its public API endpoints return an anti-forgery 403 to a bare curl, so the menu was read live in Chrome (get_page_text) after selecting the Mira Mesa location - this follows the chain-SPA technique of reading what the page renders once a specific store is chosen. Covered 7 of 7 visible categories: Limited Time Promotions, Dimsum and Sides, Platters, Rice Meals, Noodles, Desserts, Beverages. Two Rice Meals items (Rice Bowl, Chao Fan) showed no base price in the flat list because they open a modifier dialog - Rice Bowl was opened and all 9 protein choices captured as separate priced rows (base /usr/bin/bash + protein add-on, which IS the total price for that bowl); the Rice Meals 'Chao Fan' card did not open on click and its description read as a duplicate cross-reference to the Chao Fan Small/Large Platter already captured under Platters, so it was not double-counted. No third-party source checked since this is the restaurant's own live ordering platform (tier 2) with internally consistent, non-round-number pricing typical of real POS pricing (no markup signature).
